pages.text: Press $(k:key.reikocars.gps), in a car or on foot, and pick somewhere to go:$(li)$(l)Places$(): gas stations, chargers, mechanics, car washes, dealerships and every other business, nearest first, with their prices. Type to search.$(li)$(l)My Cars$(): your cars, wherever you left them.$(li)$(l)Coordinates$(): any X and Z.$(br2)A chime tells you when you've arrived.
An arrow at the top points the way, with the distance and time to go.

$(l)With Xaero's Minimap$(), the destination shows as a $(thing)GPS$() waypoint on the minimap and World Map, your cars show on the minimap, and a $(l)Waypoints$() tab lists your waypoints to head for.
